steps.content: The three puppets are gradually being contaminated, even the Void Puppet's body is plagued by black flames.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'll say this one more time, ask Hamel to lift the illusions!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Give me back my companions. We can fight, we need to find the real enemy and defeat them!

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: No... You can't... You can't crush the illusory realm...

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: I will... protect Hamel...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What can you protect while refusing to see the reality?

steps.content: You're turning a blind eye to the real crisis. The Black Ring is right here, and you're just deceiving yourself if you refuse to wake up from this so-called sweet dream. It's already taken my two companions!

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: You can't save them anyway. You're alone, you lack the power to fight and resist.
The black flames travel across the illusory lake and spread onto the Void Puppet's body. Its sanity is beginning to waver, revealing its most primal madness—It's Mania!

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: That's right, you should come too... You should join the parade, indulge in the Carnival with us, then you can see them again...

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: This is Hamel's mercy. She'll heal you too, she'll save you from loneliness... The park is her wish.
She, healing me?
You look toward the contaminated center of the lake and see Hamel almost kneeling down.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: No, she's always known she can't heal anyone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I acknowledge her kindness. She's putting in so much effort to alleviate your pain. It's probably merciful of her, and I can trust this Hamel.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But even she knows that this park is merely an illusion. That's why she keeps banishing me, banishing every human trying to enter the Carnival. She knows she can't offer real redemption.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: Shut up... Shut up... What do you know...

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: Hamel is dancing for us, we must protect her, we're protecting the Carnival...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You're only obsessing over the illusory sweet dream.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If this goes on, you'll only fall into hell with this Carnival, taking her kindness with you!
Falling into hell together... Wouldn't that be nice?
Chuckles from the black illusion come from the void.
You grow vigilant and scan the surroundings, but the black illusion is nowhere to be seen.
You don't remember me? It's me, Hamel, I'm Hamel.
Hahaha, you're right, not yet. She won't let me out, she always makes me... go back to sleep...
But I want to dance with her too, I want to share the joy with everyone, I want everyone's love too...
The black flames on the puppets grow even more terrifying with Phantom Hamel's voice.
No worries, I'll be free very soon... My dear, I'll come to you all, I'll love you all, I'll bring you all the true paradise.
I'm omnipresent, I'm the true owner of the Black Ring, this is my carnival...
You decide not to bother with the void voice, and turn to shout at the phantom in the heart of the lake.
Give my Sinners back to me! I must fight!
It's useless. That's only an illusion with preset insistence. Hamel can't watch them suffer, so she'll keep on dancing forever, until the end.

The white Hamel doesn't respond. She's still dancing, although it's almost impossible to completely purify the black flames on the mascots now. The spinning dance costume looks like white flames, about to burn her to ashes on stage.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Lift the illusions, let me return to reality and fight!

steps.speaker: Void, Fear & Misery
steps.content: Nooo...!
The black energy ball knocks you out. Standing before you are the three puppets completely controlled by the black flames and countless mascots swarming near.

steps.speaker: Void, Fear & Misery
steps.content: This is... our park...

steps.speaker: Mascots
steps.content: Banish him! Banish him!

steps.speaker: Void, Fear & Misery
steps.content: No one can... damage our park...!!

steps.speaker: Mascots
steps.content: Kill him! Kill him!
You stand up from the surface of the contaminated illusory lake, power concentrated in your palm.
Does it not hurt? Using this kind of power here must have already exhausted you, no? Can you still see clearly?

Your vision has become blurry and the sounds in your ears keep fading in and out. The glowing blue light radiating from the dancer is trying to lessen your burden, but it soon gets devoured by the contamination too.
You're surrounded by the contaminated crowd. They keep pushing and tearing at you. You're still gripping the shackles tightly, but there is no response from the other end.

options: Wake the power and fight on!

steps.content: Still resisting? Poor thing... You're all by yourself already...
